declarations.lean_elaborated_type:
Prosa.Util.Sum.sum_of_ones : ∀ (t Δ : ℕ), ∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico t (t + Δ), 1 = Δ
theorem Prosa.Util.Sum.sum_of_ones : ∀ (t Δ : ℕ), ∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico t (t + Δ), 1 = Δ :=
fun t Δ =>
  of_eq_true
    (Eq.trans
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Eq
          (Eq.trans (Finset.sum_const 1)
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun' (congrArg HSMul.hSMul (Eq.trans (Nat.card_Ico t (t + Δ)) (add_tsub_cancel_left t Δ))) 1)
              (mul_one Δ))))
        Δ)
      (eq_self Δ))
declarations.semantic_relation: compositional interval-sum equality under canonical Nat/function correspondence

declarations.lean_elaborated_type:
Prosa.Util.Sum.big_nat_eq0 : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, F i = 0 ↔ ∀ (i : ℕ), m ≤ i ∧ i < n → F i = 0
theorem Prosa.Util.Sum.big_nat_eq0 : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℕ),
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, F i = 0 ↔ ∀ (i : ℕ), m ≤ i ∧ i < n → F i = 0 :=
fun m n F =>
  { mp := fun hsum i hi => Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.mp hsum i (Finset.mem_Ico.mpr hi),
    mpr := fun hall => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi => hall i (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi) }
declarations.semantic_relation: bidirectional theorem-statement relation composed from the closed finite Nat interval-sum bridge

declarations.lean_elaborated_type:
Prosa.Util.Sum.sum_le_summation_range : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (t Δ : ℕ),
  ∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico t (t + Δ), f x < Δ → ∃ x, t ≤ x ∧ x < t + Δ ∧ f x = 0
theorem Prosa.Util.Sum.sum_le_summation_range : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (t Δ : ℕ),
  ∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico t (t + Δ), f x < Δ → ∃ x, t ≤ x ∧ x < t + Δ ∧ f x = 0 :=
fun f t Δ h =>
  Classical.byContradiction fun hall =>
    have hle :=
      Trans.trans (Eq.symm (Prosa.Util.Sum.sum_of_ones t Δ))
        (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi =>
          have hirange := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi;
          have hne :=
            Eq.mp
              (Eq.trans (Mathlib.Tactic.Push.not_exists._simp_1 fun x => t ≤ x ∧ x < t + Δ ∧ f x = 0)
                (forall_congr fun x =>
                  Eq.trans (Mathlib.Tactic.Push.not_and_eq (t ≤ x) (x < t + Δ ∧ f x = 0))
                    (implies_congr (Eq.refl (t ≤ x)) (Mathlib.Tactic.Push.not_and_eq (x < t + Δ) (f x = 0)))))
              hall i hirange.left hirange.right;
          Decidable.byContradiction fun a => Prosa.Util.Sum.sum_le_summation_range._proof_1_1 f t Δ i hne a);
    Prosa.Util.Sum.sum_le_summation_range._proof_1_2 f t Δ h hle
declarations.semantic_relation: bidirectional implication/existential theorem-statement relation over the closed finite Nat interval-sum bridge
